summary: Jackson County, OR: 40-foot L-4 lookout built about 1934-35; removed or destroyed in 1948, house salvaged 1950; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 40-foot round native timber tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1948 per the register and firelookout.com; lookout house salvaged in 1950; no source describes what remains
facts.agency: Oregon Department of Forestry (register and firelookout.com); Rogue River National Forest (Forest Lookouts)

events.note: Register and firelookout.com date the tower to 1935; Forest Lookouts gives about 1934 (see resolved_conflicts)
Panorama photos taken from the site on August 12, 1936
Register says removed in 1948; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1948
Lookout house salvaged, per the Southwest District Annual Report
Registered March 27, 2011 as US 890, OR 257; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.quote: Built in 1935, this tower was removed in 1948.

evidence.supports: firelookout.com gives a 1935 tower destroyed in 1948
Forest Lookouts gives c.1934 and a 40-foot round native timber tower with an L-4 cab
evidence.quote: c.1934: A 40-foot round native timber tower with an L-4 cab constructed.

evidence.supports: lookout house salvaged in 1950 per the Southwest District Annual Report
evidence.quote: 1950: Salvaged Poole Hill lookout house. (Southwest District Annual Report)
Poole Hill Lookout 1935 - 1948 - courtesy of Howard Verschoor collection
Poole Hill Lookout site 2007 - courtesy of Ron Kemnow

evidence.supports: location about 15 miles northeast of Ashland
administered by the Oregon Department of Forestry
firelookout.com also names the Oregon Department of Forestry
Forest Lookouts lists the site under the Rogue River National Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1935; Forest Lookouts gives c.1934. The record keeps 1935 as the structured year and the story reports both.

The register and firelookout.com name the Oregon Department of Forestry; Forest Lookouts lists the Rogue River National Forest. The record keeps the Oregon Department of Forestry value from the brief and flags the disagreement.
The register says removed in 1948; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1948. Both are kept in the event note and the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: No source describes what remains at the site today, and no access level is supported, so access is omitted. The sources agree the tower was gone by 1948 but disagree on the build year (1934 vs 1935), the agency (ODF vs Rogue River NF) and whether the 1948 end was removal or destruction. No staffing information was found beyond the 1950 house salvage. No photos added because no image URLs were captured. Stories are short because the evidence is thin.
